states.content: Plan for Asha Patel: brain MRI with and without contrast, routine EEG, levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily starting tonight, and no driving for 6 months. Levetiracetam has now been started. Clinician Dr. Mehta confirms the calendar update is fine and instructs Asha to keep taking levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily starting tonight. Clinician Dr. Mehta further instructs Asha to keep taking levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily and to keep the no-driving restriction in place, and Asha acknowledges and agrees to keep taking levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily and to keep the no-driving restriction in place. Nurse Omar reports Asha should continue levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily. Pharmacist Iris counsels levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, no driving for 6 months, and no swimming alone. Nurse Omar instructs Asha to take levetiracetam at the same morning and evening times each day, and Asha agrees to take levetiracetam at the same morning and evening times each day. Nurse Omar restates the current medicine and restrictions as levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, no driving for 6 months, and no swimming alone. Pharmacist Iris advises Asha to keep taking levetiracetam even though the routine EEG was normal, and Asha agrees to keep taking levetiracetam despite the normal routine EEG. After the MRI, clinician Dr. Mehta states the plan is to continue levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, keep no driving for 6 months from March 12, and follow up in 6 weeks after Friday's visit.

states.content: Asha Patel's updated calendar has three visits: EEG on Friday April 4 at 2:00 PM, MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM. Asha states she needs later appointments and that morning testing will not work this week. The routine EEG has now been completed without complications, and preliminary neurology review found the routine EEG is normal; nurse Omar reports the routine EEG is normal. A reminder was sent for the MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and Asha confirms she saw it; lab tech Erin reports Asha's MRI check-in is complete. Clinician Dr. Mehta reports the MRI result showed no acute lesion and no clear structural trigger seen; Asha Patel expressed relief at this result. Clinician Dr. Kim states that a normal routine EEG does not change the current plan today for Asha Patel. For the EEG, the EEG department asks patients to arrive 20 minutes early with clean, dry hair and no gel or styling products. Scheduler Noah confirms the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM remains booked and is the remaining scheduled item before closure of Asha Patel's workup.
